artist: Sibelius – Ava Bahari, Santtu-Matias Rouvali, Gothenburg Symphony Orchestra
excerpt: Over the last few years, we have reviewed several impressive performances of the Sibelius Violin Concerto: James Ehnes, Janine Jansen, Johan Dalene, and Christian Tetzlaff. Collectors are clearly spoilt for choice with roughly one hundred readily available recordings, and any new release seeking to stand out needs to offer something special. Ava Bahari's technique is unquestionably brilliant.
